name: Question 18
problem:
Given that the differential equation

$$
2{t}^{2}{y}^{″}-2t{y}^{′}+20y=0
$$

has the general solution

$$
y=t({c}_{1}\operatorname{cos}⁡(3\operatorname{ln}⁡t)+{c}_{2}\operatorname{sin}⁡(3\operatorname{ln}⁡t)),
$$

solve the initial value problem

$$
2{t}^{2}{y}^{″}-2t{y}^{′}+20y=0,\,y(1)=1,\,{y}^{′}(1)=-2,\,t>0.
$$

?

a
y(t)=2t(cos⁡(3ln⁡t)+sin⁡(3ln⁡t))
b
y(t)=3t(cos⁡(3ln⁡t)−sin⁡(3ln⁡t))
c
y(t)=t(cos⁡(3ln⁡t)−sin⁡(3ln⁡t))
d
y(t)=2t(cos⁡(3ln⁡t)−sin⁡(3ln⁡t))
e
y(t)=t(cos⁡(3ln⁡t)+sin⁡(3ln⁡t))
